018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static java.lang.String.format;
021import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
022
023import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
024import java.util.List;
025
026import org.apiguardian.api.API;
027import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.CustomTagletBase;
028import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
029import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
030
031/**
032 *  <p>{@summary This taglet replaces the standard {@code @author} taglet. It
033 *  is different in the way that it provides the author's email address as a
034 *  hyperlink.}</p>
035 *  <p>This means that the tag requires the reference to the author in the
036 *  format below:</p>
037 *  <pre><code>  &#x40;extauthor &lt;<i>name</i>&gt; <b>-</b> &lt;<i>email address</i>&gt;</code></pre>
038 *  <p>Basically, this is the name of the author, followed by their email
039 *  address, separated by a hyphen (&quot;&#x2d;&quot; or &amp;#x2d;),
040 *  surrounded by blanks.</p>
041 *  <p>If there is no email address, the output is the same as for the
042 *  standard {@code @author} taglet.</p>
043 *  <p>With Java&nbsp;15 it was not possible to &quot;overwrite&quot; the
044 *  default {@code @author} tag by a custom implementation: when providing a
045 *  custom tag with the same name, no author was added to the output at all. To
046 *  circumvent that, the {@code @extauthor} tag was introduced, implemented by
047 *  {@link ExtAuthorTaglet}.
048 *  With Java&nbsp;, &quot;overwriting&quot; is working again, and
049 *  {@code @extauthor} exists only for historical reasons.</p>
050 *  <p>You should not use both tags together, this would lead to two
051 *  &quot;<b>Author:</b>&quot; sections in the documentation.</p>
052 *
053 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
054 *  @version $Id: AuthorTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
055 *  @since 0.0.5
056 */
057@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: AuthorTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
058@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
059public sealed class AuthorTaglet extends CustomTagletBase
060    permits ExtAuthorTaglet
061{
062        /*-----------*\
063    ====** Constants **========================================================
064        \*-----------*/
065    /**
066     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
067     */
068    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "author";
069
070        /*--------------*\
071    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
072        \*--------------*/
073    /**
074     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code AuthorTaglet} instance.}</p>
075     */
076    public AuthorTaglet()
077    {
078        this( TAGLET_NAME );
079    }   //  AuthorTaglet()
080
081    /**
082     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code AuthorTaglet} instance for the given
083     *  taglet name.}</p>
084     *
085     *  @param  name    The name of the taglet.
086     */
087    protected AuthorTaglet( final String name )
088    {
089        super( name, false, Location.values() );
090    }   //  AuthorTaglet()
091
092        /*---------*\
093    ====** Methods **==========================================================
094        \*---------*/
095    /**
096     *  {@inheritDoc}
097     */
098    @Override
099    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
100    {
101        final var caption = tags.size() > 1 ? "Authors" : "Author";
102        final var template =
103            """
104
105            <dt><span class="simpleTagLabel">%1$s:</span></dt>
106              <dd>%2$s</dd>
107            """;
108        final var retValue = format( template, caption, parseNameAndEmail( tags ) );
109
110        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
111        return retValue;
112    }   //  toString()
113}
114//  class AuthorTaglet
115
